# <span id="aanchor264"></span> Create Contacts

Contacts can be created manually in the Contact Editor or in bulk using FcLoader.

 

<div class="procedure">

To create a new contact:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Company Manager** in the **Contacts** group.
3.  Click **New**.
4.  Enter a name.
5.  Assign a type, company, and email address if applicable.
6.  Populate all available information.
7.  Click **Save**.
